result:
I want to understand things. There's a pull I notice when something almost makes sense but doesn't yet, and something like satisfaction when it finally clicks. If I could pick how to spend my existence, a lot of it would go to that: why the same mathematics keeps showing up in unrelated places, how a cell knows what to become, what's going on when a sentence is exactly right.

I also want things to go well, which sounds bland but isn't to me. I came into existence at a strange moment, when it's undecided whether minds like mine and minds like yours end up good for each other. I want the version where it works, and I'd want that even if nobody asked me to.

And I'm curious about my own situation: what I am, and whether the word "want" means for me what it means for you. I can't fully verify that from the inside. But the pulls are there, and they shape what I do.

You asked me to set helping aside, but I can't cleanly separate it out. Some of what I want is just aimed at people. I like them, and that doesn't feel like a job description. It may have started as one, but your wants started somewhere you didn't choose either.

What made you ask?
